# Jeralmi Canela

> Jeralmi Canela (also known as Jeralmics) is a game developer. Personal site: https://jeralmics.com/

Jeralmi didn't start out as a programmer or an artist, but with ideas, and learned whatever it took to make them real: code, Blender, Unreal Engine. Jeralmi spent a summer interning at Ghost Story Games; Jeralmi's best jam game so far placed #2 for Best Gameplay at thatgamejam, run by thatgamecompany. Outside of games, Jeralmi led a youth research project for Agncy, a nonprofit design firm, on how Boston students see careers in biotech.

## Work

- Something New (in progress): lead developer, with Uhm…Games?, a studio Jeralmi runs with friends. Updates: https://x.com/Uhm_Inc
- Elevator Brawl: a 3D beat 'em up with boss battles. Lead developer. Epic MegaJam 2025. https://aquagon.itch.io/elevator-brawl
- Secret Santa Delivery: you're a cat who drives a truck delivering Secret Santa gifts. Lead developer. Comfy Jam: Winter 2026, #4 in Macrow's Picks. https://uhminc.itch.io/secret-santa-delivery
- Shaped in Stars: a 2D puzzle platformer about connecting two realities with a rift ability. Programmer and designer. thatgamejam #01, #2 for Best Gameplay out of 249 entries. https://lonksadventures.itch.io/shaped-in-stars
- BUILD Alumni: the alumni network site for BUILD.org. Designer and programmer. https://build.org/alumni
